label: audit-islaris
argv:
limit=$1
shift
start=$(du -sb . | cut -f1)
peak=$start
stop=none
begin=$(date +%s)
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5 "$limit" "$@" &
pid=$!
while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; do
 size=$(du -sb . | cut -f1)
 if [ "$size" -gt "$peak" ]; then peak=$size; fi
 if [ "$peak" -gt 1074516112 ]; then
  stop=disk-cap
  kill -TERM "$pid"
  break
 fi
 sleep 2
done
wait "$pid"
result=$?
end=$(date +%s)
final=$(du -sb . | cut -f1)
printf 'ANNEAL_PHASE_RESULT returncode=%s stop=%s elapsed_seconds=%s start_bytes=%s peak_bytes=%s final_bytes=%s
' "$result" "$stop" "$((end-begin))" "$start" "$peak" "$final"
exit "$result"
